h.Se você tem um negócio local — restauran: If you run a local business — restaurant, salon, clinic, store — you already know: customers almost never review on their own. When they do it spontaneously, they're usually angry. The good reviews, the ones that raise your rating and ranking, come from happy customers who were reminded to leave one.
h.A pergunta certa não é \"como faço o cli: The right question isn't "how do I get customers to review?", it's: how do I make asking for reviews a natural part of service, without being pushy? That's what this guide answers.
h.Você sobe no Google Maps. Quando alguém: You climb on Google Maps. When someone searches for "pizza place near me" or "hair salon downtown", Google ranks first the businesses with the most relevant, recent reviews. More reviews = more visibility.
h.Você vira escolha automática. Estudos do: You become the automatic choice. Studies by BrightLocal and Google itself show that over 90% of people read reviews before choosing a local business. Your rating and number of reviews replace the "word of mouth" of the pre-internet era.
h.Você baixa o custo de aquisição. Cada no: You lower your acquisition cost. Every new positive review generates recurring organic traffic — without paying per click. It's the cheapest, longest-lasting marketing asset a local business can have.
h.Ordem de grandeza: sair de 20 pra 100 av: Order of magnitude: going from 20 to 100 reviews with a rating above 4.5 usually triples the number of people who discover your business on their own on Google. It's free and ongoing.
Asking "review us!" generically. A poster on the wall saying "Review us on Google" has a conversion rate close to zero. It lacks motivation, the link and the right moment.
h.Comprar avaliações. O Google detecta pad: Buying reviews. Google detects patterns (same IP, new accounts, suspicious spikes) and punishes with a ranking drop or profile suspension. Huge risk, zero return.
Filtering who reviews you ("review gating"). Sending a survey first and only giving the Google link to happy customers is prohibited by Google's policies. It works until you get caught — and when you do, the damage is big.
h.Logo após uma compra ou atendimento que: Right after a purchase or service that went well — the feeling is still fresh.
h.Quando o cliente elogia espontaneamente: When the customer compliments you spontaneously ("wow, this looks great!") — that's a clear green light.
h.Após resolver um problema bem — clientes: After solving a problem well — customers whose problem was handled well tend to be more loyal and give higher ratings than those who never had a problem.
h.Diga \"avalie a gente no Google\" → clie: Say "review us on Google" → the customer opens Google, searches the name, finds the profile, clicks review. 4 steps. Very low conversion rate.
h.Mande um link direto pro formulário de a: Send a direct link to the review form → 2 steps. Already much better.
h.Coloque um QR Code ou uma placa NFC na m: Put a QR Code or an NFC stand on the table, counter or receipt → 1 tap. The customer taps their phone and Google opens straight to the form. Conversion soars.
h.\"Você gostaria de nos ajudar?\" convert: "Would you like to help us out?" converts better than "Review us on Google". And "Maria, your opinion would really help us improve" converts even better. The more the request feels aimed at that customer, the more they feel invited, not obliged.
h.Roteiro presencial \"Obrigado, [Nome]! S: In-person script "Thank you, [Name]! If you were happy with it, would you take 30 seconds to leave a quick review on Google? It helps us so much. [Hold out the NFC card / point to the QR / offer the phone]."
h.Cada superfície onde o cliente já vai ol: Every surface the customer is already going to look at is an opportunity:
Checkout counter — a small NFC stand. The customer taps while paying.
Restaurant table — a small table stand. Ideal after the meal.
h.Cartão de visitas — cartão de avaliação: Business card — a Google review card with NFC. Works for clinics, salons, service providers. (Unsure which format? See card or counter stand.)
h.O segredo do NFC: zero fricção. O client: The secret of NFC: zero friction. The customer doesn't need to download an app, photograph anything or type a URL. They tap their phone and Google opens. And yes, it works on iPhone.
h.Toda avaliação positiva ganha um \"obrig: Every positive review gets a short, specific "thank you" (mention something the customer said).
h.Toda avaliação negativa ganha uma respos: Every negative review gets a professional reply, without fighting. Whoever reads it later (the future customer) is watching how you react under pressure. It's an audition.
h.Tempo de resposta importa. Idealmente em: Response time matters. Ideally within 48 hours. Google notices.
h.Negócios que crescem em avaliações de fo: Businesses that grow their reviews steadily have one thing in common: they turned asking into a routine. It's part of wrapping up service, every day, with every customer it makes sense to ask. Not "whenever we remember".
h.Mês 1-3: 20-60 avaliações novas/mês, dep: Months 1-3: 20-60 new reviews/month, depending on customer volume.
h.Mês 3-6: ranking no Maps começa a subir: Months 3-6: your Maps ranking starts climbing for the most relevant searches in your category + area.
